compiled_state.title: [tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh]: SIGPIPE on echo|grep -q -> intermittent FAIL when Step 4 section is multi-line
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

### Expected Behavior
The structural test at line 95 should deterministically pass: the Step 4 section MUST contain the literal 'branch'.

### Actual Behavior
Observed during 2026-05-18 batch-fix session (PR #218 rerun): the assertion fails with 'expected: found, actual: missing' even though the SCANNER_MD's Step 4 section does contain the word 'branch'.

### Root Cause (verified)
Line 95: `echo "$step4_section" | grep -q 'branch'`. `grep -q` exits on first match, closing the pipe FD. `echo` of multi-line text receives SIGPIPE while still writing. Under `set -uo pipefail` (line 1), the SIGPIPE propagates to the pipeline status, evaluating the if-condition as false even when 'branch' is present.

### Fix
Replace the pipeline with a bash builtin substring glob:
`if [[ "$step4_section" == *branch* ]]; then`
Zero fork, zero pipe, identical semantics.
